inpaint.title: Inpaint
inpaint.promptHint: After painting the mask, edit this prompt to describe what the masked area should become. The mask chooses where to redraw; the prompt chooses what to draw. To remove an object, describe the background that belongs behind it (not the object itself), and add tags matching the original lighting and color. If edges are close to hair or skin, raise edge guard.
inpaint.negativePromptPlaceholder: e.g. blue — colors or things to avoid
inpaint.negativePromptHint: Appended to your global negative prompt. Add what to keep out of the redrawn area — e.g. the old color when changing colors.
inpaint.parameterGuideText: There is no universally correct setting. The source image, mask edge, and prompt all affect the result. Generate a preview, judge the final image, then adjust in small steps. Trying a few combinations is usually more reliable than maxing one value.
inpaint.brushSizeHint: Only changes how wide the mask brush is. It does not change generation. Use a small brush for details, or a large brush plus eraser for broad areas.
inpaint.zoomHint: Only changes the editor view size. It does not change image size or generation. Zoom in when painting precise edges.
inpaint.maskPaddingHint: Expands the mask before sending it to NovelAI so edge context is visible; final compositing still stays inside your painted mask. Try 8-24 for small fixes, 8-20 for large recolors.
inpaint.maskFeatherHint: Softly blends the generated result into the source inside your painted mask. Try 8-24 for small fixes, 8-18 for large clothing edits. Use 0-8 when complex edges need sharper protection.
inpaint.maskEdgeGuardHint: Shrinks the final pasted area inward from the painted mask edge. This lets you paint slightly over hair or skin edges. Try 4-10 for large clothing edits. Too high can leave the old color at the edge.
inpaint.colorMatchHint: Use for skin fixes or small repairs. Turn off when changing colors, clothes, or patterns, or it may pull the new color back toward the original.
inpaint.strengthHint: Controls how strongly the masked area changes. 0.35-0.5 is for repairs; 0.55-0.7 is for color or pattern changes. Too high can drift away from the source style.
inpaint.generatedKeepOpen: Keep adjusting the prompt, mask, or settings and generate again. Use View Latest Result to return to the current preview.
inpaint.previewHint: Showing the latest preview. If it looks right, use Insert Result and Finish; otherwise keep editing the mask or settings.

tagCatalog.meta: Automatic aid is enabled: independent API prompt generation sends catalog candidates from built-in catalog {version} to the AI, and final image prompts are normalized to catalog tag spellings before generation. This page is for browsing, paging, copying, and adding catalog tags.
tagCatalog.candidateSummary: Current per-call upper limit is {total} candidate tags. Each category randomly samples from the current text's matched pool; 0 means that category is not sent. Candidates are vocabulary references only, not forced scene facts.
tagCatalog.candidateRules: Candidate logic: the full catalog is not sent to the AI. Chinese text is matched through the bundled zh bridge and user triggers; English text is matched by tag/label. Each category first collects a matched candidate pool from the current text, then randomly samples up to the numbers below; a small baseline fallback is only used when a category has room left. Candidates are spelling references; the AI must still use only what the current visual moment supports. Before image generation, only equivalent tags already present in the prompt are normalized.

settings.serverPluginInstallHelpIntro: Some NovelAI advanced features require the companion backend plugin: Vibe Transfer and Inpaint. Normal /sd generation can still work with only the frontend extension installed, but these features will be unavailable.
settings.serverPluginInstallHelpStepCopy: Copy the server-plugin/auto-illustrator-nai-advanced folder from this extension repository.
settings.serverPluginInstallHelpStepConf: Paste it into SillyTavern/plugins/auto-illustrator-nai-advanced under your SillyTavern root folder. If an older folder with the same name already exists, replace it with the new one.
settings.serverPluginInstallHelpStepToke: Make sure SillyTavern already has a NovelAI API token configured. This plugin reuses SillyTavern's NovelAI token; Conso Illustrator does not need a separate token.
settings.serverPluginInstallHelpStepRest: Open SillyTavern's config.yaml, set enableServerPlugins to true, then restart SillyTavern.
settings.serverPluginInstallHelpStepRefr: After restart, refresh the page before using Vibe Transfer or Inpaint.
settings.serverPluginInstallHelpRestartN: Note: backend plugins are not frontend extensions. After changing plugin files or config, SillyTavern must be restarted; refreshing the page is not enough to load the backend plugin.
settings.vibeTransferDesc: Adds reference-image conditioning to NovelAI generation. Positive prompts, negative prompts, common tags, and SD styles still apply. Requires the companion server plugin; when disabled or empty, the normal /sd route is used.
settings.vibeTransferCacheDesc: Generation automatically matches cached Vibe encodings by the current SD/NAI model and Information Extracted value. A matching cache is reused; otherwise a new Vibe encoding is created. Vibe sets save which references are enabled, not one specific encoding.
settings.vibeTransferSourceImageDesc: Uploaded references are compressed into Vibe source images before being saved; original large files are not stored.
settings.vibeTransferReferenceStrengthDe: How strongly the reference image affects generation.
